messages:
Maya P.: quick sync — after last night's sev2 we need to iterate on the handoff bot + SLA triage flow. I think there were 2 pain points: ambiguous customer impact labels and the PM auto-schedule failing to create a postmortem in some edge cases.
Samir: saw the errors in the logs. looks like the PM-scheduler hit a 502 when the ticket title had non-ascii chars, then retried but didn't create the doc.
Lee H.: ugh. that was when we had a multi-tenant retry and the bot duplicated the action items too.
Maya P.: yeah. proposal: 1) tighten SLA triage rules (explicit labels: outage/partial-degradation/latency), 2) make postmortem creation idempotent, 3) add a lightweight action-item dashboard to track remediation owners and due dates.
Frank G.: +1 on the dashboard. can we reuse the existing action-tracker service? or do we need a small new index?
Samir: we can extend action-tracker but need an event schema change so the handoff bot emits "postmortem_created" and "action_assigned" events. simple schema:
```
{
  "event": "postmortem_created",
  "incident_id": "INC-2026-1234",
  "doc_url": "https://docs.google.com/....",
  "owner": "Maya P.",
  "timestamp": 1932104567
}
```
Maya P.: perfect. also want the SLA triage to be human-confirmed within 5m of handoff. if no confirmation, default to "partial-degradation" and page SRE oncall.
Oncall Bot: automatic note -> incident INC-2026-1234: SLA candidate set to "partial-degradation" after 5m no-confirmation.
Lee H.: can Oncall Bot add a one-click confirm UI in the thread? e.g., reaction triggers the confirmation endpoint.
Samir: doable. add a small endpoint /handoff/confirm that accepts incident_id + label. then the bot watches for :white_check_mark: reaction.
Frank G.: we should also normalize customer impact language for external comms. marketing/legal want a consistent phrase set. add to postmortem template.
Maya P.: yes — I'll draft a template snippet. idea: short summary, customer impact (enum), timeline, root cause, mitigations, action items. snippet:
```
Customer impact: [outage | partial-degradation | latency-only]
Affected customers: <count or names>
User-facing break: yes/no
SLA impact: <minutes/hours>
```
Samir: note about idempotency — we'll add a dedupe key when creating docs: `create_key = incident_id + bot_version`. if doc exists, return existing URL.
Ops Coordinator Bot: scheduled reminder -> postmortem draft due in 72h for INC-2026-1234. Assignee: Maya P..
Maya P.: assigning owners: Samir for bot changes, Lee for triage UX (confirm UI + reactions), Frank for dashboard design + legal comms mapping. I'll own the template and postmortem automation end-to-end. target: MVP in 2 sprints?
Lee H.: 2 sprints sounds fine. can we scope MVP to: reaction confirm, idempotent doc creation, and a tiny dashboard that lists open actions with owner/due? leave auto-schedule extras for phase 2.
Samir: agree. i'll open PRs for the event schema + dedupe logic this week. will add unit tests around non-ascii titles.
Frank G.: I'll prototype the dashboard tiles and include a CSV export. legal wants audit logs -> add an 'audit_events' tab.
Maya P.: action items:
- Samir: PR for dedupe + event schema (owner + due) — due 1932700000
- Lee H.: confirm UI + reaction handler spec — due 1932600000
- Frank G.: dashboard mockups + csv/audit plan — due 1932800000
- Maya P.: postmortem template + comms phrases — due 1932550000
Please add these to the action-tracker and tag owners. I'll kick off a weekly sync next Tue. :thumbsup:
Samir: added tasks to action-tracker and linked incident. ping me if you want me to pair on the dashboard integration.
Lee H.: noted, will post a short spec in #eng-oncall/design later today.
Oncall Bot: reminder -> reaction-based confirmation enabled for INC-2026-1234. use :white_check_mark: to confirm SLA within 5m window.
Frank G.: quick Q — do we want to surface customer-impact severity in the status page? that might be a separate product/product-ops decision. I can bring it up in next PM sync.
Maya P.: yes, bring it up. for now keep internal only. product can decide after we have a consistent signal.
Samir: one last thing — add telemetry metric `handoff.confirmation_latency` so we can measure compliance.
Maya P.: good call. ok team — thanks. will follow up with calendar invite for the weekly sync and the postmortem doc link.
Frank G.: thanks all. :rocket:
Samir: thanks, signing off.
Lee H.: thanks!
_meta: Generated Slack thread about handoff bot, SLA triage, postmortem automation and action tracking - thread includes root message and replies in chronological order. Includes bot messages, code snippets, action items, and owners.
